items.name: Occupancy Remedy
items.purpose: Reusable professional follow-up with independently acquired evidence and qualified dispositions
invariants: Two static slots; no arbitrary authority targets or external biography.
Neither a payment nor recognition decree creates new Eastbank historical proof.
generationEnvelope: Ordinary claimant labels and document rendering only; roles, truth structures and consequences stay authored.

allowedTruthStructures: A live underlying dispute with retained supporting record
A procedurally valid remedy may leave historical cause unresolved
pressurePatterns: Parent Case deadline remains active; a follow-up does not retroactively cancel it
generationSlots: bounded ordinary claimant label; not a new canonical office or identity

perspective.publicDescription: A bounded property follow-up can be opened after a supported disposition, including a remedy for delayed intervention.
